{{Quote|As is no doubt common knowledge across Naboo, His Excellency Lord Felmarath of Theed recently lost his daughter Zawe to a tragic death. A cruel pack of wild predators beset her as she rode her guarlara not far from His Excellency's country estate.|Master [[Waymo Rion]]|<ref name="SWG:ADoLF" />}}
[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Felmarath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He lost his daughter [[Zawe]] some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:ADoLF" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Felmarath was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ADoLF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
